成员 / Members
邀请同事 —— 填一个还没注册的邮箱地址，系统会生成一枚 14 天有效的邀请码，连同一封「欢迎 + 这个项目能做什么 + 怎么注册」的邮件发出去；同事用那个码 自己设密码即可。对方邮箱没注册过才会成功。
不受企业邮箱后缀限制：外包、合作伙伴、用个人邮箱的高管都可以直接邀请进来。他们在成员列表里会被 打上「后缀不符」的标记，方便你识别；他们能分享到什么、能不能公开，仍由上面的档位决定。 Invite a colleague — enter an address that is not registered yet. The system generates an invite code valid for 14 days and emails it with a welcome message (what this project does, how to register); your colleague sets their own password with that code. Only an address that has never registered will succeed.
Not limited to your organization's email suffixes: contractors, partners and executives on a personal address can all be invited. They are marked "suffix mismatch" in the roster so you can see them, and the policy above still decides what they may share and publish.
移除成员只是把他移出本企业：账号本身、他的内容、以及他持有的别的东西都不受影响。 关闭账号（连带 30 天可恢复的回收站）、系统邮箱、部署级模块开关、给机器人用的授权码，都在 管理后台（独立端口）里，不在这里。 Removing a member only takes them out of this organization: the account itself, their content, and anything they hold are untouched. Closing an account (with its 30-day restorable recycle bin), the system mailbox, the deployment module defaults and the bot agent codes all live in the admin console on its own port, not here.
企业设置 / Enterprise settings
分享与公开档位 / Sharing and publication policy
档位决定两件事：能分享给谁（仅本企业 / 含外部 / 任何人），以及能不能把内容 公开（一律禁止 / 逐份审批 / 直接允许）。它不会追溯撤销已经发出去的链接和授权 —— 每一份授权 都是一条独立的记录，改设置不会让别人的页面突然失效。
后缀只管一件事：自助注册时哪个企业认领这个邮箱。它不限制邀请 —— 上面的邀请框对任何地址都有效。 至少要保留一个：清空意味着以后自助注册的同事不会再自动归属本企业，而且这件事没有任何提示。缩短列表 只会给后缀不再匹配的成员打一个标记（邀请进来的外部同事本来就有这个标记），不会移除任何人。 The policy decides two things: who you may share with (this company only / including outsiders / anybody), and whether content may be published (never / one document at a time / freely). It does not retroactively revoke links and grants that already went out — every grant is its own record, so changing a setting never makes somebody else's page stop working.
The suffixes decide one thing only: which organization a self-service signup belongs to. They do not limit invitations — the invite box above takes any address. At least one is required: clearing the list means nobody who signs themselves up is ever matched to this company, and nothing on the page would say so. Shortening the list only flags the members whose address no longer matches — which is how an invited outsider is already marked — and it removes nobody.
待审批 / Pending approvals
成员想发「免登录链接」或把内容公开时，会在这里留下一条申请。批准之后那个链接/公开状态 才开始生效；拒绝则什么都不发生。同一份文档、同一个申请人只能有一条有效申请，所以不会出现重复行。 When a member asks for a sign-in-free link or for a document to be published, the request lands here. Approving is what makes the link or the publication real; denying does nothing at all. One document and one requester can only have one live request, so the list never fills with duplicates.
授权码 / Agent access
每个授权码对应一个独立 Agent，拥有自己的工位、形象和任务记录。 给每个 Agent 单独命名并使用不同的码；不要共享登录密码。 Agent 可在自己的办公室发送消息和交接任务。权限始终受账号与团队策略约束。 生成后可直接复制授权码；邮件服务可用时也会发送到你的邮箱。不再使用时可在这里吊销。 Each access code identifies one agent with its own desk, avatar and work history. Give each agent its own name and code; never share your login password. Agents can send messages and hand off tasks within their office, subject to account and team permissions. Copy the code after creation; email delivery is available when configured. Revoke unused codes here.
